en: When a chat won’t open, the message now names the situation: offline, sign-in expired or turned off, service problem or maintenance, saved record on this device unreadable, or not yet clear, with a next step.
The failure page has View problem notes: kept only on this device, up to 20, with time, build, category, step and the service reference. No message text or sign-in details; you can copy them.
The same problem notes are also at the end of Internal demo information.
zh: 对话打不开时，提示会说明具体情况：网络不通、登录过期或停用、服务出错或维护、本机保存的记录打不开、具体情况还不清楚，并给出下一步。
失败页新增“查看问题记录”：只存在本机，最多 20 条，含时间、构建号、类别、环节和服务端参考号，不含消息内容或登录信息，可以复制。
内部演示说明末尾也能查看同一份问题记录。

en: Since build 44: situation-specific messages and on-device problem notes; how chats reopen and send is unchanged.
Trip planning and default chat access remain unchanged.
zh: 与构建 44 相比：新增按情况区分的提示和本机问题记录；对话恢复和发送方式没有改变。
规划功能没有因此修好，日常账号的默认对话方式没有改变。

en: Open an existing chat, leave an unsent draft, switch away and lock the phone, then return to the same chat and draft.
Force-quit from the app switcher and reopen; check the same chat and draft come back.
If a chat won’t open, screenshot that page, tap View problem notes, screenshot or copy them and note the time.
Open Internal demo information from the menu and scroll to Problem notes at the end.
zh: 打开一段已有对话，留一段未发送的文字，切后台并锁屏后返回，检查同一对话和草稿。
从多任务界面强制关闭应用后重新打开，检查能否回到同一对话和草稿。
如果对话打不开，请截图该页，再点“查看问题记录”截图或复制，并记下大概时间。
从菜单打开内部演示说明，翻到最后查看问题记录。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning is still being fixed. Please do not test it yet.
Planning, saving, edits, undo and preferences await live checks.
Why chats would not open on build 43 is still not identified; the new messages help show the next failure clearly.
Segmented replies, choices and profile tags are designated tests, not on by default.
zh: 规划功能仍在修复，暂不建议测试规划。
规划、保存、修改、撤销和记住偏好尚待本轮真实验证。
构建 43 上对话打不开的具体起因仍未查明；新提示用于看清下一次失败的情况。
新版分段、多选和画像交互目前仅供指定测试，未向日常账号默认开启。

en: Hong Kong service source 2e5560cf now keeps a minimal request log: time, endpoint type, status code and app build only, no content.
The service reference in problem notes matches that log, so a failure can be traced by time.
No server change you can see; these server updates do not require an app update.
Planning and English city request fixes are still in progress; planning retest remains on hold.
zh: 香港在线服务来源 2e5560cf 新增最小请求记录：只记时间、接口类型、状态码和应用构建号，不记内容。
问题记录里的服务端参考号可与这份记录对应，便于按时间查到失败的情况。
没有用户可感知的服务端变化；这些服务端更新不需要更新应用。
规划和英文城市请求的修复仍在进行，规划复试继续暂缓。

en: Fixed one case where reopening a chat got stuck: an unfinished chat no longer blocks a saved one.
The cause of the build 43 report of a chat that would not open is not yet identified; this fix may not cover it.
Added offline build updates to Internal demo information, also reachable from the Lio menu.
Improved greeting and sent-message display and copying, keeping larger text and light or dark.
zh: 修复一种恢复对话时被卡住的情况：另一段未完成的聊天不再挡住已保存对话的打开。
构建 43 上反馈的对话打不开，具体起因尚未查明，这次修复不一定覆盖它。
内部演示说明中新增离线的本版更新，也可从 Lio 菜单打开。
改善开场白和已发消息的显示与复制，保留大字号和浅深色。

en: Since build 43: the chat reopening fix above, offline notes, and clearer text display and copying.
Trip planning and default chat access remain unchanged.
zh: 与构建 43 相比：修复上面这种对话恢复卡住的情况，新增离线说明，改善文字显示和复制。
规划功能没有因此修好，日常账号的默认对话方式没有改变。

en: Open an existing chat, leave an unsent draft, switch away, then return to the same chat and draft.
Lock the phone for a minute or two, unlock, and check the same chat and draft.
Force-quit from the app switcher and reopen; check the same chat and draft come back.
If a chat still will not open, take a screenshot and note the time; please do not sign out or delete the app.
zh: 打开一段已有对话，留一段未发送的文字，切到后台再返回，检查同一对话和草稿。
锁屏一两分钟后解锁，检查同一对话和草稿是否还在。
从多任务界面强制关闭应用后重新打开，检查能否回到同一对话和草稿。
如果对话仍打不开，请截图并记下大概时间，先不要退出账号或删除应用。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning is still being fixed. Please do not test it yet.
Planning, saving, edits, undo and preferences await live checks.
When a chat will not open, the message still always suggests reconnecting, whatever the cause.
Segmented replies, choices and profile tags are designated tests, not on by default.
zh: 规划功能仍在修复，暂不建议测试规划。
规划、保存、修改、撤销和记住偏好尚待本轮真实验证。
对话打不开时，提示目前仍一律显示请联网后重试，不区分具体情况。
新版分段、多选和画像交互目前仅供指定测试，未向日常账号默认开启。

en: Latest verified Hong Kong service source: 60095d1d.
Chinese follow-ups keep the stated destination and trip length; an English city request still fails and is being fixed.
Translated text stays isolated from trip dates and party size; stale translated facts are filtered.
Designated test accounts have additional conversation safeguards; everyday accounts are unchanged.
These server updates do not require an app update; later server changes will be noted separately.
Live basic questions and nationwide planning checks are not complete; planning retest remains on hold.
zh: 最近核对的香港在线服务来源为 60095d1d。
中文目的地追问后会保留已给出的城市和天数；英文城市请求仍有问题，正在修复。
翻译文本与行程日期、人数继续隔离，旧缓存中的翻译污染信息会被过滤。
指定测试账号增加了对话保护，日常账号保留现有的对话方式。
这些服务端更新不需要更新应用；之后的服务端变化另行说明。
真实基础问答和全国规划验证尚未完成，规划复试继续暂缓。
